Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?

The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?

The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?

Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

What is the Trump Members-Only Club?

The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel Oman?

Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.

What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?

Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.

What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?

The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.

When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.

Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?

The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.

What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?

Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.

Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it?

What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?

Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?

The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

Are you considering buying a villa in Riyadh? Awesome choice! Whether you're drawn by the allure of luxurious living or the promise of a sound investment, there's no denying that a villa in Riyadh for sale is an enticing proposition. When you look at a villa for sale in Riyadh, you're not just buying a property but investing in a lifestyle. These villas offer expansive living spaces, state-of-the-art amenities, and a level of privacy and comfort that’s hard to beat. From contemporary architectural marvels to opulent traditional designs, the variety in Riyadh villa for sale options is astounding. And the best part? The Best Neighborhoods for Buying a Villa in Riyadh
Now, let's talk specifics. Where should you look if you're in the market to buy villa in Riyadh? The city is brimming with neighborhoods that each offer something unique. Whether you prioritize proximity to business districts, access to top-notch schools, or simply a peaceful retreat from the city’s hustle and bustle, a Riyadh villa for sale fits the bill.

Olaya is one such neighborhood that’s hard to beat. Centrally located, it's perfect for those who want to be in the thick of the action. It’s close to major commercial centers and offers many dining and entertainment options. Then there's Al Muhammadiyah, a quieter, upscale neighborhood ideal for families. The villas here are often more extensive, with ample garden space – perfect for those weekend BBQs or a calm evening under the stars.

If you're after something truly luxurious, check out the properties in Al Nakheel. This area is synonymous with opulence, featuring some of the most extravagant villas for sale in Riyadh has to offer. The architectural styles here range from sleek, modern designs to more traditional Arabian aesthetics, each villa more impressive than the last.

But perhaps you’re looking for something a bit different? Duplexes for sale in Riyadh are also an excellent choice, offering a unique blend of villa-like space and apartment-like convenience. These properties are viral among smaller families and young professionals looking for a bit more room without sacrificing the benefits of city living.

Beyond Villas: Exploring Other Properties in Riyadh
While villas are undoubtedly the stars of Riyadh's real estate market, they're far from the only option. Are you interested in an apartment for sale in Riyadh? Apartments here come in all shapes and sizes, from compact studios perfect for singles to sprawling penthouses with breathtaking city skyline views. The apartment market in Riyadh is incredibly diverse. You’ll find options ranging from affordable units in bustling neighborhoods to high-end residences in exclusive districts. Many of these apartments are in modern, high-rise buildings with amenities like gyms, pools, and 24/7 security, offering convenience and luxury.

And let’s not forget about land for sale in Riyadh. If you have a vision for your dream home that no existing property can fulfill, buying land might be the way to go. This opportunity gives you the flexibility to design and build your villa precisely as you want it and your personal preferences. With Riyadh's rapid growth, investing in land can be a wise financial move.

For those seeking a mix of villa-like space and apartment-like community living, duplexes for sale in Riyadh present a compelling choice. These properties often feature two separate living spaces within one structure, offering versatility and privacy. They are perfect for multi-generational families or those who frequently host guests.

Living the Riyadh Lifestyle: Attractions and Amenities
Living in Riyadh is more than finding the right property; it's embracing a vibrant, dynamic lifestyle. The city has many attractions and amenities that make everyday living a pleasure. Whether you're a culture buff, a shopaholic, or a foodie, Riyadh has something to offer. You can explore them by checking out the best places to visit in Riyadh.

One of the must-visit spots is the Riyadh Gallery Mall. This shopping paradise is a haven for those who love retail therapy. From high-end fashion stores with brand names to quirky local stores, there’s something for every shopper. Plus, the mall features endless dining options to cater to every appetite, from international chains to local eateries serving delicious Saudi cuisine.

The National Museum of Saudi Arabia is a must-see for a dose of history and culture. This impressive museum takes you on a long educational trip through the Kingdom's rich history and heritage. It’s an enlightening experience that gives you a deeper appreciation of where you consider calling home.

Let's remember King Abdullah Park, one of Riyadh's most beloved green spaces. It's a perfect spot for a stroll, a family picnic, or morning jog. The park's beautiful landscaping and serene atmosphere make it a wonderful escape from the city's hustle and bustle.

In conclusion, whether you’re looking for a villa for sale in Riyadh, an apartment, or even a plot of land to build your dream home, Riyadh's real estate market has something for everyone. The city's blend of modern amenities and rich cultural heritage makes it an extraordinary place to live. So, take the plunge, explore the options, and find your perfect property in this fantastic city!

Yes, many villas in Riyadh come with private amenities such as swimming pools, gardens, and maid’s rooms. Filters on property platforms help you easily find these features.
